title: Plan your trip — Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
publisher: UTMB World Series / HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
claims: Doi Inthanon National Park Headquarters (GPS 18.5367, 98.5218) serves as expo, bib collection, start and finish for the first week of the competition on 28-29 November 2026.
The Headquarters is about 100 km from Chiang Mai PAO Park and about 2 hours away, and about 30 km from the main road turn-off plus another 16 km uphill to the summit.

About 500 m from the Headquarters there are shops and restaurants, a camping ground with equipment rental, and local resorts, guesthouses and homestays, with most local communication requiring Thai via Facebook or LINE.
Accommodation that is easier to find on booking platforms is available in Chom Thong District, about 30 km and 30 minutes away.
Shuttle bus services run between Chiang Mai province, Chom Thong District and the race venue throughout the event.
An Airport Line shuttle runs from Chiang Mai International Airport and Chiang Mai city for THB 400, with bookings through inthanon.utmb.world.
